integrity: Analytical proof with independently assembled finite monomial Gram-matrix comparisons. Finite computations do not certify the all-degree theorem.
scientific_limitations: General spectral pairing and central multiplicity apply to all finite polynomial degrees and positive reflection-invariant densities, but the complete noncentral spectrum is explicit only at degree two for uniform ball measure. Historical novelty is provisional; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Universal half-energy multiplicity and an exact quadratic half-ball Slepian spectrum
